Features

Easy to start, hard to put down

⚡

Skim the edge, score double

Thread a gate with a hair to spare and you earn a close call. Chain them for a combo, a screen shake and a gold flash.

🎧

Music that follows you

An EDM soundtrack is generated live and builds with your score. Layers kick in as you climb, and the sound muffles when you pause.

📴

Offline and instant

No account, no ads and no connection needed. The whole app is under half a megabyte and opens straight into play.

How to play

One thumb is all you need

Tap

Tap to boost upward. Let go and gravity pulls you down.

Squeeze

Squeeze through the glowing rings. Each gate is a little tighter and a little faster than the last.

Chase

Chase your best score and a higher pilot rank.

Climb the pilot ranks

Every run pushes your rank higher, all the way to the top of the sky.

FAQ

Quick answers

How do I install it?

Tap download, unzip the file on your phone, then open FlapsterOrb.apk and follow the prompts.

Why does Android ask about this source?

The app comes as a direct package rather than from a store, so Android asks you to allow installs from this source the first time.

Do I need an account or internet?

No. There is no account, no ads and no connection needed. It opens straight into play.

Which Android versions work?

Android 6.0 or newer. The download is about 0.4 MB.

Can I try it without installing?

Yes, use the Play in browser button to jump in right away.
